description:
Get the disclosed corporate-action timeline for ONE STOCK, HISTORICAL (splits, bonuses,
    dividends, etc.) — the per-stock, backward-looking sibling of get_market_calendar (whole-
    market, any window, all event types merged) and get_upcoming_results (whole-market, forward-
    only results convenience). Use this tool, not get_market_calendar, when you want one
    company's corporate-action history rather than a market-wide view.

    Accepts NSE symbol, ISIN, or BSE code. `years` (1..20, default 5) bounds the window.
    `types` optionally filters to a subset of action types. Newest first; raw disclosures.
name: get_corporate_actions
